paths.description: Homepage and catalogue: primary discovery surface, desktop/mobile layout, preferences, performance, accessibility, privacy and memory.
Representative title detail and Watch Online journey.
Movie listing archetype reached from the primary desktop navigation; exposes a broken route and recovery state.
Promoted app-download landing archetype and fallback destination.

findings.evidence: The CSS feature probe found no prefers-reduced-motion rule, while 17 animations with 200 ms durations remained present under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce layer that removes non-essential carousel and state motion while preserving instant state feedback.

findings.summary: Route and player state changes swap abruptly without View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS/source feature probe found no view-transition or startViewTransition use; the recorded Watch Online journey cuts directly to the player state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for route and player-state changes, with the reduced-motion layer disabling non-essential motion.

findings.summary: Persistent navigation does not communicate scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show fixed-size persistent navigation, and the CSS probe found no scroll-state container query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Let persistent chrome compact or otherwise signal the scrolled state using scroll-state queries with a non-supporting-browser fallback.

findings.summary: Repeated cards adapt only at viewport level, not to their container.
findings.evidence: The 200 KB CSS feature probe found no @container, container-type, or container-name despite cards and rails being reused at desktop and mobile sizes.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare containment on reusable rails/cards and use size container queries, retaining the existing viewport rules as fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and control names are frequently invisible or absent.
findings.evidence: The focus walk computed outline-style none on navigation links and icon buttons; many buttons had empty text and no aria-label. Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.82 and also found label/name problems.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and accessible names to every icon-only carousel/navigation control; verify the complete keyboard order.

findings.summary: The advertised primary watch flow cannot be completed in the tested region.
findings.evidence: Clicking Watch Online ends at “The source is unavailable in your region” and redirects the user toward the app, so the promised browser viewing flow dead-ends.
findings.suggestedFix: Check availability before presenting Watch Online, label unavailable titles clearly, and offer genuinely playable regional alternatives without forcing an app detour.

findings.summary: Load performance and Core Web Vitals are poor.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 19.4 s, FCP 3.9 s, CLS 0.24, TBT 316 ms and performance 0.40. The CDP trace corroborated three long tasks and 124 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the hero LCP resource, defer below-fold rendering and third parties, and split long main-thread tasks.

findings.summary: Unreserved imagery causes severe mobile layout shift.
findings.evidence: The 360 px layout observer measured CLS 0.370. The image audit found all 100 images lacked width and height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image space with width/height or aspect-ratio and ensure placeholders use the final asset ratio.

findings.summary: Main-thread work remains heavy during load.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded three long tasks up to 103 ms and Lighthouse measured 316 ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the Nuxt hydration and ad callbacks, split tasks at interaction boundaries, and defer non-critical work until idle or scroll end.

findings.summary: The page ships an excessive, poorly cached resource graph.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 226 requests and 6.75 MB transferred, including 115 images (5.21 MB), 48 scripts, 15 high-priority stylesheets and many large images without cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold rails, consolidate critical CSS, lazy-load non-essential scripts, deduplicate image variants, and add durable immutable caching to fingerprinted assets.

findings.summary: Accessible names, image alternatives, headings and focus structure are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 13 images without alt text; Lighthouse failed image-alt, frame-title, label-content-name-mismatch and heading-order; the DOM probe found numerous unnamed buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Name icon controls and frames, mark decorative images with empty alt, provide meaningful alternatives for content images, and repair heading/landmark order.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because the document declares maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions, then test reflow at 200% and 400% zoom.

findings.summary: Hydration, ad, fetch and frame-navigation errors pollute runtime.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a Nuxt hydration mismatch, failed third-party fetches, disabled ad errors, and sandboxed-frame attempts to navigate the top-level page.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate hydration mismatches, remove failing or disabled ad integrations, and isolate third-party frames so they cannot attempt top-level navigation.

findings.summary: Navigation and indexing signals contain broken or invalid targets.
findings.evidence: The desktop Movie navigation href returns the site’s 404 page; /sitemap.xml resolves to a 404 sitemap-like URL; Lighthouse also failed crawlable-anchors and hreflang.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair the Movie route and anchor targets, publish a valid sitemap at the declared location, and emit valid reciprocal hreflang links.

findings.summary: Baseline browser security headers and secure cookie attributes are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers probe found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. All four observed cookies lacked Secure; mb_token was not HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and HSTS, add nosniff/frame/referrer/permissions policies, and mark session/token cookies Secure, HttpOnly and appropriately SameSite.

findings.summary: Third-party tracking and advertising footprint is disproportionate.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe observed 18 third-party origins, including Google Analytics and Yandex; Lighthouse reported 42 third-party cookies, while ad scripts attempted external navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove low-value ad/tracker vendors, gate optional analytics behind informed consent, minimise event collection, and sandbox remaining integrations.

findings.summary: Most catalogue content is absent from the no-JavaScript representation.
findings.evidence: Discoverability comparison found only 28% word overlap between rendered content and raw HTML; the crawler view contains only a hero while rendered rails contain hundreds of titles.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render meaningful catalogue sections and crawlable links, then hydrate enhancements without replacing the core content.

findings.summary: “Watch free” messaging leads to an undisclosed login/payment or app detour.
findings.evidence: The page and title promise free browser streaming, but Watch Online reaches an unavailable-region state plus “Please log in before payment” without prior pricing or commitment disclosure.
findings.suggestedFix: Disclose availability, price, account requirements and app-only restrictions before the call to action; keep decline/back paths obvious and equivalent.

findings.summary: Asset and third-party resource use is wasteful for the delivered page.
findings.evidence: The home load transferred 6.75 MB across 226 requests; images accounted for 5.21 MB, repeated promotional variants were each about 300 KB, and 18 third-party origins ran on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an evidence-based page-weight budget, deduplicate and right-size promotional images, defer offscreen rails, and eliminate background third-party work without immediate user value.

taskList.title: Make the advertised browser watch journey truthful and completable
Cut LCP, request count and image weight
Reserve image dimensions and eliminate CLS
Deploy security headers and secure cookies
Repair keyboard focus, names, headings and alternatives
Repair Movie route, sitemap, anchors and hreflang
Honor reduced motion and add state transitions
Adopt component and scroll-state responsive techniques
